newsitem.title: USA: Grupo Televisa in pact with Lockheed Martin.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Televisa in pact with Lockheed Martin.

text.p: Grupo Televisa SA de CV said Monday it has a tentative agreement with Lockheed Martin Telecommunications, a subsidiary of Lockheed Martin Corp, to create a venture to develop, distribute, and market consumer entertainment, information and other content products and services with advanced technology.
The Grupo Televisa statement gave no details on the venture's organization or terms. It did include statements from officials of both companies.
"This is an ideal combination of complementary skills: Televisa's artists and Lockheed Martin's engineers," Telecommunication President Russell McFall said.

"Entertainment delivered 'Direct to Home' via broadband telecommunication networks will rapidly evolve towards content tailor-made to the preference of each member of the household. In that sense, the stage that follows DTH is what we have called DTP: Direct to People, which we are committed to launch and lead," said Grupo Televisa Chief Financial Officer Guillermo Canedo White.
